recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The change is a narrow consistency fix for a current build-scope mapping page and completes the FHIR-13896 link pattern found elsewhere in mapping-page sources and templates.
issue_request: FHIR-13896 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested a general page explaining that FHIR mapping pages are informative/instructive rather than normative or executable, with a comment asking that mapping pages link to that page.
initial_application: The issue was originally applied in svn revision 13429, represented by git commit db3234082a6ae6418a1d99f1a9df495fb401d54b, which added source/mappings.html and linked several then-current hand-written mapping pages to it.
additional_context: Current source/mappings.html still states the correct informative, non-authoritative, non-normative guidance. Current resource/logical/profile/extension templates and other hand-written mapping pages already link to it; source/types-mappings.html was the only checked current mapping-page source/template lacking that link. A 2025 Zulip thread supports the same distinction by describing core mappings as definitional or high-level rather than operational transforms.
reconciliation: Updated source/types-mappings.html to link to mappings.html with the established "Mappings to Other Standards" wording.
source_changes: source/types-mappings.html: Added a link to mappings.html in the introductory paragraph.
